result.summary: The food-delivery home screen is mostly intact; the only clear visual defect is a promo badge showing a nonsensical “-0%” discount.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card displays a “-0%” badge, which is not a meaningful discount and looks like leftover or incorrect promo data.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is 0%, or show a real offer (e.g. “-20%”) if one applies.
